arc_checks: All active nodes on the stated circle and plane, single ordered chain with uniformly seeded angles.
Chord sum compared to exact 2 N R sin(theta/(2 N)); true arc R theta reported separately, never incorrectly required to equal polyline length.
common_checks: Only requested first-order top-dimensional family; unique node and element IDs; connectivity fully resolved; no degenerate cells or silent drop.
Exact top-cell and active-node counts; one chain or edge/face-connected component.
All expected lattice nodes and cells are present with required ordering, within coordinate tolerance; unused arc center 0D node allowed.
Physical groups 110/111 form nonempty disjoint exhaustive patch partition.
Shared boundaries use identical native node IDs, opposite orientation, exact prescribed divisions/layers; no hanging nodes or partial face matches.
Analytic measure relative error <=1e-9; quad area from local-origin polygon triangles, hex volume from Gauss quadrature.
SDK errors fail; warnings recorded and explicitly reviewed.
coordinate_scale: Maximum pairwise source-corner/line-point distance, arc radius, or extrusion-vector length. Positive characteristic length L; geometric tolerance is 1e-9 L.
design: Six per family: three normal, two difficult supported, one unsupported; N3 and D2 are withheld until recipe freeze. Exactly 18 fixed cases, no post-failure replacement or weaker gates.

metrics.SICN: Report SDK minSICN separately. It is not the independent scaled Jacobian and not a solver Jacobian.
metrics.hex: Gmsh standard Hex8 corner signs; det(dX/dxi,dX/deta,dX/dzeta)>0 and determinant/product(column norms) at 27 samples. Integrate independent volume with 2x2x2 Gauss quadrature.
metrics.quad: At each corner, dot(cross(next-current,previous-current),source_unit_normal) divided by the two edge norms. Strictly positive determinants; independent polygon area.

native_mapping_boundary: Read existing native fixtures/codec only. Line2 needs explicit TRUSS/BEAM mechanical interpretation and property; BEAM orientation is not inferred from line geometry. Q4->SHELL and Hex8->BRICK require first-order ordering/properties. Full generated native workflow remains F3.
quality_scope: Reasoned initial-family admission gates, not an official engineering quality standard or proof for arbitrary trilinear hexes.
scope: Gmsh recipe F2 only: line/unique short arc; one/two convex planar quad patches; common positive straight, possibly oblique, extrusion. No product adoption, native generation or Windows claim.
time_includes: Fresh process start, recipe import and SDK initialization/generation/write/reopen, independent ASCII MSH verification and result serialization.
unsupported: Explicit ValueError limitation/validation failure before successful mesh/report, within 30 seconds; unknown semantic options must not be silently ignored.
